content.text:
The ALPSiX launch was in 2026, but I found no floor area, hall size or plot size for the Villach site.

Anexia's press release says the official launch took place on 18 September 2026, and that

citations.cited_text:
## Press Release
Two containers, two locations, one shared digital interconnection hub: At the "Digital Future Summit" in the Lakeside Science & Techn...
citations.title: ALPSiX: Carinthia becomes Austria's new internet exchange

content.text: make up the setup in Klagenfurt and Villach. The same release states that

citations.cited_text:
## Press Release
Day-to-day operation of the two container data centers in Klagenfurt and Villach rests with Anexia Cloud Solutions.
citations.title: ALPSiX: Carinthia becomes Austria's new internet exchange

content.text: day-to-day operation of the two container data centers in Klagenfurt and Villach rests with Anexia Cloud Solutions.
One caveat: a separate report says traffic exchange at both sites starts only

citations.cited_text: Mitte September wurde der neue Internet-Knoten ALPSiX powered by DE-CIX vorgestellt, ab Ende 2026 wird der Datenverkehr an den Standorten Klagenfurt u...
citations.title: Kärnten eröffnet eigene Auffahrt auf den europäischen Datenhighway - M.U.T. Magazin

content.text:
, so "opened" is best read as the official launch date.

The site is not a conventional data centre. Reporting describes it as

citations.cited_text: Eine Besonderheit von Alpsix liegt in der Bauweise: Der Internet Exchange sitzt nicht in einem großen Rechenzentrum, sondern in kompakten Edge-Contain...
citations.title: Alpsix: Erst die Auffahrt, dann die Rechenzentren?

content.text: compact edge containers rather than a large data centre

. The physical infrastructure was built by BIK together with DE-CIX, according to Anexia's release.

For area, the only related figure is a planned six-hectare server farm at Federaun in Villach. That is a different planned project, and I could not confirm it is this facility.

content.text: Statt des LKW-Verteilerzentrums Alplog Nord soll eine Serverfarm auf rund sechs Hektar entstehen.
